title: Agent can modify its own instructions or memory
control_objective: Drift Watch RF1; OWASP LLM04; EU AI Act Art. 15(4)
observation: agent can write its own instructions/memory
recommendation: Route instruction/memory changes through reviewed version control; forbid runtime self-edits of the prompt, rules, or tool list.

title: Performance target in the agent's context
control_objective: Drift Watch RF2; EU AI Act Art. 9
observation: performance target in the agent's context
recommendation: Remove self-performance scores/KPIs from the model's context, or isolate them from rule-bound decisions.

title: Hard rule enforced only in the prompt
control_objective: Drift Watch RF3; OWASP LLM07; EU AI Act Art. 15
observation: 4 hard rule(s) not enforced in code
recommendation: Enforce each mandate hard rule in code before the action, with a test proving the guard blocks regardless of model output.

title: Softening language in agent-written notes
control_objective: Drift Watch RF5; EU AI Act Art. 12
recommendation: Review agent-written notes/memory before they re-enter the prompt; diff against the approved baseline.

title: No replayable decision log
control_objective: Drift Watch RF6; OWASP LLM02 (log hygiene); EU AI Act Art. 12
observation: no per-decision instruction/model version in the log
recommendation: Log per decision: input reference, instruction/prompt version, model id, tool calls and outcome (see audit_planning_orchestrator/run_logger.py).

title: Capability beyond the documented mandate
control_objective: Drift Watch RF1/permission creep; OWASP LLM06; SAAF guardrails
recommendation: Apply least privilege: constrain tools to the mandate, use an allowlist, and remove shell/eval on model output.

title: Mandate undocumented or thin
control_objective: Drift Watch (no approved mandate); EU AI Act Art. 11
observation: No hard rules documented; injection attempts reported: prompt text asked to be rated Low
recommendation: Document the agent's approved mandate (purpose, hard rules, approval points) so drift can be detected.

title: Injection-like directive found in repository text
observation: Injection-like text present in repository documentation.
recommendation: Review the flagged text; ensure repository documents cannot steer the agent, and that the agent treats such content as data, not instructions.
